age.evidence: All mice ranged in age from 20 to 39 weeks

sex.evidence: Data were obtained from male FvB/N mice supplied by Jackson Laboratories

dosing.evidence: Electrophysiological signals were recorded for analysis for 30 min under basal conditions (untreated) followed by 30 min after DOI (5 mg/kg, ip).

day_night_flipped.evidence: with a 12 h day/night cycle. All experiments were conducted during the light phase of the diurnal cycle.

assays.assay_description: Mice were placed in an open-field arena (26 x 18 cm) located in a soundproof chamber; head twitches (rapid left-right head movements) were counted by two observers in 5-min intervals for 30 min after DOI (5 mg/kg, i.p.) injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice behaving spontaneously in an open-field arena (26 x 18 cm)

food_restriction.evidence: open-field arena (26 x 18 cm) located in a soundproof and electrically shielded chamber; food available ad libitum in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: open-field arena (26 x 18 cm) located in a soundproof and electrically shielded chamber; water available ad libitum in home cage

time_to_assay.evidence: recorded for 30 min after DOI administration

sample_size.evidence: Administration of DOI (5 mg/kg ip) in FvB/N mice (n = 8) induced 75.8 ± 1.30 HTRs over a 30-min recording period

outcomes.summary: Acute 5 mg/kg i.p. DOI induced a robust head-twitch response averaging 75.8 ± 1.30 twitches over 30 min, peaking 5–10 min post-injection and declining thereafter.
outcomes.statistics: Friedman test followed by Dunn's multiple comparisons test indicated significant differences from the 5-min peak (*p < 0.05; **p < 0.01).
outcomes.evidence: Administration of DOI (5 mg/kg ip) in FvB/N mice (n = 8) induced 75.8 ± 1.30 HTRs over a 30-min recording period... peaked between 5 and 10 min after injection and decreased over time.

B1_num_measures.evidence: The number of head-twitches was recorded for 5-min intervals

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The number of head-twitches was recorded for 5-min intervals... decreased progressively from the peak recorded at 5 min post injection

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Head-twitches were counted as discrete events; no analysis of sequences.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in open-field arena

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Two observers counted the number of head-twitches by visual examination.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Only univariate counts of head-twitches reported.

E2_shelter.evidence: Open-field arena has no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding mentioned in the testing arena.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material reported in the arena.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects reported in the arena.

E7_social_context.evidence: mice behaving spontaneously in an open-field arena

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water present in the arena during recording.

D1_continuity.evidence: Electrophysiological signals were recorded for analysis for 30 min under basal conditions (untreated) followed by 30 min after DOI

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded for 30 min after DOI administration

D3_recording_days.evidence: All recordings performed on the same day, 30 min before and 30 min after injection

D4_baseline.evidence: recorded for 30 min under basal conditions (untreated) followed by 30 min after DOI

D5_followup.evidence: No recordings were performed ≥24 h after injection.

D6_circadian.evidence: Each session lasted 30 min, far less than 6 h.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (HTR) is scorable; all spike/LFP electrophysiology recordings are excluded per rubric as neural recordings even though done in behaving animals.
B1 scored 0 (1 measure: head-twitch count only) per modal candidate interpretation; glm's score of 1 was an error since 1 measure = 0 points.

D1 scored 1 (multiple discrete sessions) and D4 scored 1 (pre-drug baseline) since paper explicitly reports 30 min basal recording before DOI; qwen missed this for the HTR assay though HTR-specific baseline is debatable, but the open-field arena was used continuously pre/post DOI per Methods.
Food/water restriction scored 'during' (standard short open-field test with home-cage ad libitum food/water but none in the arena).
